correctness.rationale: Classified complete-biclique 3-colorings into three Q_m plus three Q_n cubes arranged at six junctions. Missing-edge colorings have one repeated color only on removed-edge endpoints, and other two colors fixed on opposite remaining shores: exactly six extra states, each two neighbors adjacent to a junction through a same-length square ear. Ear detours are removable so old-old distances persist. Contract each cube between opposite junctions to alternating m,n arc-lengths on a circle of length 3(m+n); distances between distinct cubes are circle distances, same-cube distances Hamming. Opposite positions witness D=floor(circumference/2) for all states, including ears via neighboring portals. Nontrivial cross-block cycles must traverse ring giving odd girth when length odd. Independently enumerated all named proper coloring assignments, recoloring edges, BFS distances, old-old isometry for (2,2),(2,3),(3,3), not used as all-parameter proof.
residual_risks: Finite checks only corroborate, not replace the all-parameter proof.
